note: Examples for the schema, not game content. A place has rooms, and each room offers the actions whose ids begin with the listed prefixes.

rooms.name: The yard
rooms.text: Mud, a well with a cracked lip, the plough under the eave and the dog that is not yours but eats here.

rooms.name: The byre
rooms.text: Warm with breath. The ox, when there is an ox, and the hens in the rafters.

rooms.name: The hearth
rooms.text: One room, one fire, the bed behind the curtain and the table that was a door.

rooms.name: The field
rooms.text: Eleven strips between the stone and the stream. Barley on seven, fallow on four, and the hurdles that keep moving.
